requirements.text: 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role (FDE, SWE w/ consulting, or technical founder)
Production LLM experience: prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, deployment at scale
Strong programming in Python, ideally a second language (TypeScript / Java)
High agency, navigates ambiguity in complex organizations
High cooperation mindset for cross-organizational collaboration
Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI through creative technical applications
Strong communication; discovery with customers and conveying technical concepts to diverse stakeholders
Background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical (plus)
Experience with enterprise IT systems and/or AI deployment patterns (plus)
Experience working as an FDE or in a professional services context (plus)
Former technical founders are encouraged to apply
Deliver technical artifacts for customers: MCP servers, sub-agents, agent skills, production workflows
Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns; contribute insights back to Product and Engineering

e.athena.platform-ops.title: Platform Operations across athenahealth platform products

e.athena.federated-ai-operating-model.title: Federated AI operating model — moves operational teams from experimentation to repeatable AI-enabled execution
e.athena.federated-ai-operating-model.description: Architected and executed an AI operating model that scales by federation rather than central evangelism. Components: AI enablement programs, builder office-hours communities, operational automation portfolio, reusable AI/data assets, and the agent-assisted development operating model.

e.athena.ai-enablement-communities.title: AI enablement programs and builder communities — pipeline from learning to production
e.athena.ai-enablement-communities.description: Office-hours-style communities and structured cohorts that create a practical pipeline from learning to production. Operators arrive with a workflow, leave with a working prototype.

e.athena.automation-portfolio.title: Operational automation portfolio across Support, Onboarding, Enablement, Data Operations
e.athena.automation-portfolio.description: Codified, prioritized, and assignable backlog of operational automation opportunities — replacing scattered initiatives with a managed portfolio.

e.athena.reusable-ai-data-assets.title: Reusable AI and data enablement assets
e.athena.reusable-ai-data-assets.description: Shared repositories, OAuth tooling for warehouse access, 'SME-in-a-Box' prompt/agent patterns, delegated builder-license models. Lets domain experts encode themselves into a reusable form so the right people can build without central bottlenecks.

e.athena.governed-analytics-platform.title: Governed analytics platform — shared SQL models, semantic tests, validation gates, data contracts
e.athena.governed-analytics-platform.description: Built on top of an enterprise warehouse-backed analytics stack (Snowflake). Unifies operational and warehouse data into reusable, validated models; downstream consumers get a stable surface to build against. Establishes what the data is.

e.athena.local-first-packages.title: Local-first analytics package delivery (warehouse → Parquet → DuckDB)
e.athena.local-first-packages.description: Packaging patterns with manifests, validation, provenance, and launch flows. Stakeholders run versioned analytics packages in a browser or locally without standing infrastructure. The right pattern for customer engagements with data residency, network, or speed-of-iteration constraints.

e.athena.agentic-dev-operating-model.title: Agent-assisted development operating model — task packets, scoped worktrees, validation, closeout memory
e.athena.agentic-dev-operating-model.description: The operating model the federated builder community uses for agent-assisted development. Task packets in, durable closeout memory out. Scoped worktree blast radius. Staged review. Validation gates. Evaluation artifacts. The artifact an FDE could leave behind that keeps a customer going.

e.athena.ai-case-intelligence.title: AI case-intelligence workflows — embeddings, vector similarity, clustering, historical-resolution matching
e.athena.ai-case-intelligence.description: Applied embeddings, vector search, clustering, and LLM-assisted analysis to support-case operations. Turns historical institutional knowledge into an active input on every new case.

e.athena.source-first-publishing.title: Source-first publishing pipelines (Markdown → docs / decks / web / video)
e.athena.source-first-publishing.description: Pipelines that convert structured Markdown sources into documents, decks, web artifacts, Confluence pages, and videos. Same artifact, multiple readers. The principle this application repo uses.

e.athena.continuity-work.title: Data-product continuity work (security response, MFA rollout, support transition, cost initiative)
e.athena.continuity-work.description: Cross-functional data-product continuity work over 2024–2025: a customer credential / account-trust response, a multi-wave MFA rollout, a Tier 1 support transition to a global partner team, and a Snowflake cost-savings initiative through partner-account consolidation. Quantified outcomes documented internally.

e.athena.pop-health-greenfield.title: Built Population Health support from greenfield (2017)
e.athena.pop-health-greenfield.description: Joined as analyst on Pop Health as it was being integrated into athenaOne. There was no support structure for the complex data operation. Built the entire case-support process, knowledge bases, and operational infrastructure.

e.athena.dataview-operationalization.title: Operationalized enterprise data product (warehouse-backed client offering)
e.athena.dataview-operationalization.description: Took raw athena production-data warehouse that had come through analytics/IT with no operational structure and built the support, ops, and integration to turn it into a productized client offering.

e.athena.aco-support.title: ACO support — value-based care, care management, quality reporting, financial analytics

e.robotics-press.python-stack.title: Python-primary production stack
e.robotics-press.python-stack.details: Python across robotics-press, robotics-press-engine, robotics-press-agents, robotics-press-publishing, sourdoughcheatsheets.com. TypeScript in healthcare-data-training and postiz-app. Astro for publishing frontend.

e.robotics-press.llm-traces.title: llm_traces wrappers across LLM call sites
e.robotics-press.llm-traces.description: Production observability pattern for LLM calls — backfilled wrappers across remaining call_llm_json sites (PR #282). Demonstrates eval-friendly instrumentation discipline.

e.robotics-press.tool-registry.title: Shared tool registry — define once, assign per agent (PR #391)
e.robotics-press.tool-registry.description: Tool definitions live in a registry; agents subscribe to subsets. Mirrors the design intent of MCP server-side capability discovery.

e.robotics-press.shared-patterns.title: Repeatable patterns codified across 12+ repos
e.robotics-press.shared-patterns.description: Engine/agents/publishing/dashboard/sandbox/harness/research/intelligence/bizops are separated by concern; modular split of watchdog.py and email_comms.py (PRs #387, #386); state machine for PUBLISHED → REMEDIATION; systemd services for scheduled work.

e.robotics-press.production-stats.title: Live production stats
e.robotics-press.production-stats.stats: 1,275 commits in May 2026 across 18 repos; 4,435 GitHub contributions in the last year; site live with 2.8K articles, 40.7K signals, geospatial CIDE map covering 31.7K sites.

e.healthcare-data-training.title: healthcare-data-training — curriculum design for non-technical healthcare workers using agentic AI
e.healthcare-data-training.thesis: A new class of healthcare worker is emerging: clinically/operationally fluent, not technically trained, suddenly empowered by Claude Code / Codex / Cursor to do work that previously required a data engineer.
e.healthcare-data-training.scope: 7 personas, 43-course landscape teardown, 10 funnel teardowns, 6-module curriculum spec (1,402 lines), GTM plan (3,000 lines).
e.healthcare-data-training.relevance: Directly maps to the FDE customer profile in healthcare — Bill already thinks about how non-technical enterprise users adopt Anthropic tools.

e.parlant-fork.relevance: Demonstrates active study of customer-facing agent patterns — exactly the FDE problem space.
